gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Probitas Syndicate 1492 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 17.876 million in 2020. This mixed development comprised a GBP 19.353 million release from the 2019 year of account, indicating favourable claims development and a benign year with minimal large loss activity. However, there was a GBP 1.477 million strengthening for the 2018 and prior years of account, partly influenced by the less favourable Supreme Court ruling on the FCA's business interruption insurance test case, which led to potential additional exposure for property-related claims.
